question: What is the Heart that always shines forth?
premises: The emitted reality is proclaimed as pure being.
The Heart is full and of the nature of 'I'.
Its shining is the flashing of the union of Śiva and Śakti.
inference: The Heart is the ever-shining fullness of being, identical with the 'I' as the flashing union of Śiva and Śakti.
plain_english: That is then proclaimed as pure being; this full Heart, of the nature of 'I', always shines forth as the very flashing of the union of Śiva and Śakti.
